messages:
anna: Hey team — I opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/31245 that changes KV eviction thresholds and adds a fallback routing path for quantized-small models. Need eyes from runtime + infra + security so we can schedule a canary tonight. cc @jia @ralph @lyn @mike

mike: looking now, can you attach the perf smoke results? any latency regressions?

anna: quick summary pasted below (ran on staging with pinned-model workload):
```
p95 latency: baseline 48ms -> branch 49ms (+1ms)
throughput: 1200 rps -> 1196 rps (within noise)
kv-hit-rate: 87% -> 88%
errors: 0 -> 0
```
no functional changes to API; mostly eviction threshold and route fallback logic.

jia: I can take the runtime review — will check KV atomicity and cache invalidation semantics. what's the canary cadence?

anna: plan: canary in us-west, 50 req/s for 2 hours, monitor kv hit rate, p95, and error-rate. immediate rollback if p95 > 30ms above baseline or errors > 0.5%. roll-forward if stable.

ralph: infra question: does this require any config migration or feature flags on the orchestration side? If so we need ops PR and a merge window.

anna: added a feature flag (runtime.kv.eviction_v2=true) guarded in the PR; infra will need to add flag default off in ops repo and enable during canary.

sec-bot: automated note: PR touches KMS call site (key selection code). Security review required for customer KMS usage + audit logging. Please confirm key usage and add audit flag.

lyn: I can do security review in ~1h. quick question: are we introducing any new plaintext logging of keys or tokens?

anna: no new plaintext logs. KMS usage switched to use customer_key_id when present; added audit_log=true in call sites.

mike: SRE: fine with canary if we add alerting: p95 spike alert (30ms over baseline), kv-hit-rate drop (< 70%), and error-rate > 0.5%. I'll add alerts and watch during the window.

jia: runtime notes: minor nit in PR about atomic swap in kv_eviction path — I'll push a tiny fix (one-line) and re-run unit tests. nothing blocking otherwise.

ralph: infra ok in principle but I need an ops PR to flip the flag and a short maintenance window (10m) to coordinate. I'll open ops PR and link it here before merge.

lyn: security: reviewed, conditionally approved. Please ensure customer_key_id is validated and KMS errors are surfaced (don't fail open). Add one-line to runbook to confirm audit logs post-canary.

anna: thanks — assigning reviewers: @jia (runtime), @ralph (infra/op), @lyn (security). target merge tonight 23:00 PT after canary if all green.

jia: pushed the atomic-swap fix, CI green.

ralph: ops PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/1287 — added the feature flag with default off and a rollout plan.

mike: alerts configured and calendar event set for 23:00 PT window. I'll be watching.

lyn: confirmed security checklist added to PR and runbook. ack from sec.

anna: CI passed, infra PR linked, sec acked, runtime LGTM. ready for canary. will proceed at 23:00 PT. Thanks everyone :rocket:

mike: :+1: watching the canary.

sec-bot: Audit reminder: ensure KMS logs are retained per compliance retention policy.

anna: noted — retention is already configured in ops PR. final status: ready for merge post-canary if no alerts.
